verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de exposes webhook-style events (e.g. `appointment.completed`, notarization completion notifications) with HMAC signature verification, letting external systems react automatically to platform events — a foundation for automation-on-event. However there is no evidence of an in-product rule-definition UI or conditional logic engine; users must build the 'if event, then action' logic themselves in their own system. Missing for 10: a native rules/trigger builder, support for multiple event-condition combinations, and documentation of a broader event catalog beyond a couple of named events.
